question: What did the 16 September 2016 GR setting up the state DBT committee say?
gold_answer: Not in this corpus. It is cited by the GR of 14-05-2021, which reconstituted that committee

gold_grs_detail.title: Reorganization of Dicrect Benefit Transfer Action Committee at State Level for Direct Benefits of Government Schemes

product.answer: The 16-09-2016 GR establishing the state DBT committee is not among the corpus texts. The 2021-05-14 GR (reorganization of DBT Action Committee) cites it by referencing the government decision dated 16 September 2016 (Maatans 054/31/2016/39) and states that the DBT Cell constituted thereunder is being reconstituted with a new membership list. No corpus GR reproduces the original 2016 text.

product.answer: The 16 September 2016 GR established the state DBT committee under Government Resolution No. मातंसं ०५४/३१/२०१६/३९. A later GR dated 14-05-2021 reconstituted that committee with a new composition, listing the Additional Chief Secretary (Finance) as Chairman and the Director (IT) as Member Secretary.
